text_block_list.name: Queen of Ice
text_block_list.text:
You will understand soon enough— 
on the night of the full moon, three days 
from now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three days later, on the night of the full 
moon— 
Guided by the words of the Queen of Ice, 
we returned to the King of the Night's 
abode.

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
So, the full moon is here three days 
later, 
but what are we supposed to figure out? 
We haven't found any of the kidnapped 
villagers either—
...Mmmh...—*mumble mumble*...

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
The voice came from over here—wait, what?! 
What is all this? There are people 
everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Could these people be... the villagers?! 
Though they appear to simply be asleep, 
tucked warmly beneath fluffy blankets...

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
...There's magic cast all around them too. 
A protective magic circle. But why—

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text:
...Everything was the doing of the 'King 
of the Night.'

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text:
The secret art of resurrection required 
the crimson gem, 
rhodonite, and—the breath of the innocent.

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text:
...Once, when the Empress reigned, 
this land was filled with bountiful 
harvest. 
All through the Empress's power of 
abundance.

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text:
And now, that power is needed once more. 
That is why the King of the Night acted—to 
revive the Empress.

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text:
—All for the sake of the people of this 
land.

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
For the abundance of this land...!? 
Then you should have just explained that 
from the start...!

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides, doing so to save everyone— 
then could it be that this person... is 
not evil at all?

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
—... To know nothing of the secret art. 
That was the condition to be an 
'innocent.'

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore... whatever my motives were, 
it is an undeniable fact that I kidnapped 
them and instilled fear.

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text: ...If so, then I must bear the blame.

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
—! 
......The time has come.

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
—O Empress. 
Reign over this land once more...—

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Once more, grant those people a bountiful 
land— 
Ngh, please—!

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text: ! This presence—

text_block_list.name: Demon Empress
text_block_list.text:
—You have done well, Dura. 
Your voice has reached me loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Demon Empress
text_block_list.text:
As has the breath of the villagers. I 
thank you all. 
My gratitude to each of you—and now, the 
time has come to awaken.

text_block_list.name: Young Villager
text_block_list.text:
Yaaawn... Felt like I was havin' a nice 
dream or somethin'— 
Wait, huh? Is it still night?

text_block_list.name: Demon Empress
text_block_list.text:
Sprout, ye grass! Bloom, ye flowers— 
May eternal abundance bless this land!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a gentle rustle—the flora suddenly 
takes 
deep root into the earth, and verdant 
grass and blossoms 
flourish in rich, vibrant hues.

text_block_list.name: Young Villager
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, incredible! I don't really get it, 
but— 
at this rate, our fields'll produce a 
bumper crop even if we leave 'em alone! 
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
S-So the villagers are safe, the Empress 
is revived— 
and the land has become bountiful... is 
that how it goes—?!

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
...— 
Even so, that does not wash away my sins.

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Now I shall accept retribution for my 
heinous deeds. 
Whatever the punishment may be—come.

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, geez! If you do that, we'll end up 
looking 
like the bad guys! No way, I hate that!

text_block_list.name: Young Villager
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's head home! Gotta go see 
if the veggies I was growin' got real big!

text_block_list.name: Ice Queen
text_block_list.text:
......— 
It seems we have safely reached the 
desired ending.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus, demons and humans came to live hand 
in hand, 
and peace settled upon the land. 
—And they lived happily ever after.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. A heartwarming tale. 
This role—I shall perform it with utmost 
dedication.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I happened upon Duramente as she was 
reading a story. 
Seeing her smile with such gentle, serene 
contentment— 
it warmed my heart as well.
